```artifact
Feature: Alarms and Temperature Sensing

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is operational
    When a battery failure is detected
    Then the battery failure alarm should have high priority

  Scenario Outline: System can sense the temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is operational
    When the temperature of the <element> is measured
    Then the temperature should be accurately recorded as <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Examples:
      | element            | temperature |
      | blower motor       | as specified|
      | battery cell       | as specified|

  Scenario Outline: GUI reads temperature sensors
    Given the system is operational
    When the GUI reads the temperature of the <element>
    Then the GUI should display the temperature as <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Examples:
      | element            | temperature |
      | blower motor       | as specified|
      | blower power mgmt system | as specified|
      | battery cell       | as specified|

  Scenario Outline: Blower motor temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is operational
    And the blower motor temperature threshold is set to <threshold> degrees Celsius
    When the blower motor temperature reaches <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified + 1 |
      | as specified | as specified - 1 |

  Scenario Outline: Blower power system temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is operational
    And the blower power system temperature threshold is set to <threshold> degrees Celsius
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified + 1 |
      | as specified | as specified - 1 |

  Scenario Outline: Battery temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is operational
    And the battery temperature threshold is set to <threshold> degrees Celsius
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm should be triggered
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | as specified | as specified |
      | as specified | as specified + 1 |
      | as specified | as specified - 1 |

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked for blower power system
    Given the system is operational
    And the blower power system temperature threshold is set to <threshold> degrees Celsius
    When the blower power system temperature reaches <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Then the safety action should be automatically invoked
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | as specified | as specified + 1 |

  Scenario Outline: Safety action invoked for battery
    Given the system is operational
    And the battery temperature threshold is set to <threshold> degrees Celsius
    When the battery temperature reaches <temperature> degrees Celsius
    Then the safety action should be automatically invoked
    Examples:
      | threshold | temperature |
      | as specified | as specified + 1 |
```
